resources.string: Captures the current screen for visual feedback reports.
Open the page you want to review, then use Quick Settings or S Pen Air Command to capture it.
This is where your marked-up pages will appear. Capture from the app you want to review using Quick Settings or S Pen Air Command.
Visual QA stays out of the way while you review the page underneath it.
1. Open the page you want to review
2. Open Quick Settings and tap Capture feedback
3. Mark the issue and add comments here
Try again. Existing files are kept on this device.

Visual QA uses the Accessibility Service to read the on-screen layout. This lets us identify which UI element you want to report on. We do not read passwords, payment card numbers, or other text from secured input fields. No data is sent off-device without your explicit export action.
Notifications are used to show capture progress and alert you when a report is ready. All processing stays on your device.

Screenshots, annotations, and reports are saved to the app\'s private storage. You can delete them at any time from the draft list. Exported files you save to Downloads leave app storage under your control.
Network access is used only when you explicitly export a report via the share sheet or save to Downloads. No background uploads, no telemetry, no analytics.
